league.name: Shoot the Shits

sourceCheck.note: All four leagues: CFN feed standings and Week 12-14 matchups matched Yahoo exactly (records, points for/against, ranks, matchup pairs).

sources: Yahoo league home page standings table (#standingstable) and Week 12-14 scoreboards (?matchup_week=N&module=matchups), fetched 2026-11-25T20:42:49Z (GL/BH a few minutes earlier)
Yahoo league Settings pages (2026), captured in the CFN history package evidence/<league>/2026/settings.json
CFN rules data (tools.rules in client/api/_resources.json): playoff format per league and STS custom standings rules
CFN history package identities.json (owner identities, all status=verified)

rules.byes: Seeds 1 and 2 get a first-round bye (Week 15)
rules.yahooPlayoffTieBreakerSetting: Best regular season record vs opponent wins (applies to tied PLAYOFF games, not regular-season seeding)
rules.tiedGamesPossible: Yes in principle (Yahoo records W-L-T); extremely unlikely with fractional scoring. Not enumerated in this analysis.
rules.customStandingsRules: Each week: win matchup = 4 points; score in the top 6 of all 12 teams that week = 3 points (independent). Win + top 6 = 7, win only = 4, top 6 only = 3, neither = 0.
tiebreakerOrder: Total points scored on the season (points for)
Unknown beyond points for (exact points-for tie not documented)
rules.standingsPointsCheck: CFN feed customRows match 4 x wins + 3 x top-six weeks for all 12 teams; top-six weeks recomputed independently from collected Week 1-11 scores and matched (no 6th/7th ties in any week).

analysis.scope: Qualification analysis covers ALL remaining regular-season weeks (12-14) at the level of standings-point totals; it is exact for status, win-out and point thresholds, but conditions on other teams are NOT enumerated. Week 12 scenarios cover the upcoming week only.
assumptions: Standings and schedules are as of Week 11 final; Week 12 has not been played (source check 2026-11-25 20:42 UTC).

Every remaining regular-season game (Weeks 12-14) is assumed to have a winner. Yahoo can record a tied game (W-L-T, counted as half a win in win percentage); ties are NOT enumerated. If any game ends tied, rerun the analysis.

Future fantasy scores are unknown. Whenever a team can finish tied at the cutoff, the result is marked TIEBREAKER-DEPENDENT; current points-for leads are shown for information only and are never treated as a guaranteed tiebreaker win.
An exact tie in season points for (after the primary tiebreaker) is not modeled; the tiebreaker order beyond points for is not documented.
Weekly top-6: exactly 6 of 12 teams; a matchup loser can be top-6 only if its winner is too. Exact score ties at 6th/7th are not modeled (none occurred in Weeks 1-11).
unresolved: Clinch/elimination conditions that depend on OTHER teams' results are not enumerated for STS; POSSIBLE scenarios are not sufficient on their own.
Week 12 clinch checks cover only each team's own Week 12 result (regardless of other results); combinations with other Week 12 results are not enumerated.
TIEBREAKER-DEPENDENT is not separated out for STS: any non-GUARANTEED path may involve the points-for tiebreaker.
Yahoo's regular-season seeding tiebreaker is not shown on its settings page; points for is taken from the CFN site ranking and the league owner's confirmation.
analysis.method: Exact integer programming (scipy.optimize.milp / HiGHS) over all feasible Week 12-14 outcomes (each week: 6 matchup winners and a top-6 scoring set consistent with those results; ~7.3e11 combinations total). Verified by 400,000 random feasible outcomes (consistency check, not a proof).
notes: Yahoo marks I Like Tets (by win-loss; official STS seeding uses custom points, where it is also clinched) as clinched (*), consistent with this analysis.
